finding.protocol_requirement: EVALUATION_PROTOCOL_V1 requires at least three historical market environments to be covered or separately marked before the first holdout observation.
finding.previous_gap: EVALUATION_BINDING_FORMAT and invest/evaluation.py did not require a machine-readable historical market environment field, so a structurally valid binding could omit that frozen protocol requirement.

changes: Require historical_market_environments in every protocol-v1 BOUND_UNOPENED binding.
Require at least three environments with unique names, non-duplicate date ranges, real dates, evidence text and dates within the frozen overall evaluation time boundary.
Document the field as an implementation alignment to the already-frozen method rather than a new evaluation method.
Add adversarial tests for insufficient environments, duplicate names/ranges, out-of-bound dates and reversed dates.

local_validation.note: Credential-free reconstruction used the existing frozen source checkpoint plus the current evaluation files; no provider call or real market data was used.

next_safe_action: Wait for legally authorized real provider data; then verify provider boundaries and create the first BOUND_UNOPENED binding including at least three frozen historical market environments. Keep holdout closed unless every gate passes.
merge_policy: Draft PR only; no automatic merge and no direct main write.
